parameters.query:
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN $1::uuid
    ELSE NULL::uuid
  END AS lead_id
)
UPDATE public.atendimento a
SET status = 'FINALIZADO'::status_atendimento,
    finalizado_em = COALESCE(a.finalizado_em, now())
FROM entrada e
WHERE e.lead_id IS NOT NULL
  AND a.lead_id = e.lead_id
  AND a.status = 'EM_IA'::status_atendimento
RETURNING a.id, a.lead_id, a.status, a.finalizado_em;
